Scope: the implemented service complaint module. Controller/service operations and complaint-specific entity fields are shown; generated members are omitted.
User and Service show relevant members only. Shared collaborator types are named in service attributes; their internals are outside this module.
Status and outcome are String fields: PENDING / RESOLVED; null / DISMISS / REMOVE. REQUEST_EXPLANATION keeps PENDING; the provider replies to staff.
Each image value belongs to a complaint XOR an event within this workflow; lists accept at most five images per submission. ModerationLog.targetId is not a JPA foreign-key association.
DTO components are read-only; nested record names identify their enclosing class. Typed attributes and drawn associations describe the same references.
